subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up — SSO / KMS / Logging requirements
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@fintechco.com>, Daniel Huang <daniel.huang@fintechco.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's call — deployment mode considerations

Hi Sarah and Daniel,

Thanks for the call earlier — really helpful to understand FintechCo's production constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Key constraints you raised:
- SSO: Okta SAML-based SSO + SCIM provisioning required (enterprise directory).
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys required; preference for BYOK with HSM-backed key material for production.
- Logging retention: Regulatory requirement of 7 years for audit logs (transaction metadata + audit trails).
- Data residency: Primary requirement US-only.

Implications for Redwood deployment modes:
- Hosted API: fastest but limited for BYOK HSM and long-term log retention out of the box.
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS and stronger isolation; log retention configurable but may require integration with your long-term storage.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full control — supports BYOK/HSM options and arbitrary retention policies; higher onboarding/back-office work.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll loop in Rishi (security) and Logan (solutions) to confirm technical options around KMS/HSM and log retention.
2) Can you share the compliance contact and any SOC2 / audit templates you require?
3) Let's schedule a 30–45min follow-up architecture call next week (I'll send calendar options).

I've attached a short SOC2 summary and a deployment checklist to help surface any additional gaps.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, deployment-checklist.xlsx

From: Daniel Huang <daniel.huang@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call — deployment mode considerations

Thanks Marissa — sorry, quick note from our side:

We'd prefer Dedicated as the default path if it can meet the BYOK/HSM requirement and support pushing logs to our long-term retention store (S3 Glacier Vault) with 7-year retention. Private is fine if Dedicated can't meet those requirements, but our procurement and infra teams will push back on full Private unless it's necessary.

A couple of clarifying questions:
- For Dedicated, can we bring our own KMS keys (customer-managed) and have HSM-backed key material?
- Is there an automated export pipeline for logs to our S3 (we need daily export and append-only retention)?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) for the commercial side — they may ask for an NDA or security questionnaire.

— Daniel
Director of Engineering, FintechCo

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Huang <daniel.huang@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@fintechco.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call — deployment mode considerations

Hi Daniel / team — looping in with technical details on the constraints you called out. Short answers first, then details: 

- KMS/HSM: 
  * Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) where keys can live in your cloud KMS (AWS KMS / Google KMS / Azure Key Vault) and be referenced by our Dedicated control plane. HSM-backed key material depends on your cloud KMS configuration; we don't manage HSMs on the customer's behalf for Dedicated, but we support keys that were created with HSM protection.
  * Private (VPC / on-prem): fully supports BYOK with HSM integration (we can work with your HSM vendor for key import or integrate with your on-prem HSMs).

- Logging / retention:
  * Hosted: default retention is 30 days for request logs; not suitable for your 7-year requirement.
  * Dedicated: we can configure log forwarding to your S3 bucket; retention is controlled by your bucket lifecycle/policy. Typical setup: daily batched exports + append-only objects to a customer-controlled bucket — supports long-term retention (you handle Glacier lifecycle).
  * Private: full control — you configure logging and retention to meet 7 years.

- SSO / SCIM:
  * We support SAML 2.0 SSO and SCIM provisioning across Dedicated and Private. Hosted supports SAML for user access but SCIM provisioning for large enterprise syncing typically requires Dedicated or Private for integration with your IdP.

Next steps from our side:
1) We'll prepare a short tech note summarizing Dedicated vs Private for BYOK/HSM and the log export pattern (I can share a template infra diagram).
2) If you'd like, we can run a short proof-of-concept on Dedicated to validate key retrieval and log export (2–3 week timescale depending on approvals).

Marissa — happy to take the lead on the POC scope.

— Rishi
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call — deployment mode considerations

Great — thanks Rishi and Daniel. Attached is the SOC2 summary (quick view) and the deployment checklist I mentioned. I'll also put together a proposed POC scope: 
- Objective: validate Dedicated can meet BYOK (cloud KMS HSM-protected keys) + automated daily log export to your S3 bucket.
- Success criteria: (1) key reference works from Dedicated runtime; (2) automated daily export lands in your S3 (append-only) with lifecycle policy applied; (3) SAML SSO test user provisioning via SCIM.

Proposed time: 2–3 weeks after paperwork and infra access are confirmed. I'll send calendar options for an architecture call — would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for you?

Best,
Marissa
